bagPolicy.summary: You can bring a small bag to most shows. Large bags, including messenger bags and backpacks, must be left at coat check, and bag check is free at the Fine Line.
prohibited: Large bags, messenger bags and backpacks (must be checked)
bagPolicy.quote: You may bring a small bag with you to most of our shows.

parking.summary: First Avenue has no official parking lot for its venues. The Fine Line is next to a paid surface lot and metered street parking.
parking.quote: Fine Line is adjacent to a paid surface lot and metered street parking.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Fine Line. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The Fine Line is a cashless venue, and the bars take debit and credit cards. If you only have cash, you can buy a gift card onsite to use for drinks, tickets and merch.
concessions.quote: The Fine Line and Palace Theatre are cashless venues.

accessibility.summary: All First Avenue venues, including the Fine Line, are wheelchair accessible. To reserve accessible accommodations, email info@first-avenue.com or call (612) 338-8388, Monday through Friday 10am to 6pm, at least 24 hours before the show.
accessibility.quote: All venues owned and operated by First Avenue are wheelchair accessible.

reEntry.summary: Fine Line hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: AXS Mobile ID in the AXS app is the main form of entry, and will call delivery is available for most events if you don't have a smartphone. You need a valid, unexpired photo ID to enter and to claim will call tickets, and you must meet the age limit listed for the show.
ticketPickup.quote: Yes, you will need a valid Photo ID to enter our venues, and also to claim will call tickets.

gates.summary: Fine Line hasn't published doors and entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
